The authority and routing boundary, the authorization policy, the advisory lens sections and the model selection note remain. The file contains one role mapping table whose set of role names equals the keys of INTERNAL_ROLE_PROMPTS exactly; the test fails for a role missing from the table and for a table role absent from the runtime. The existing retired-token and current-contract checks over this file still pass.
